milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the red sandstone structure (centered at spawn-relative ~7.5, ~1.5, ~7) and face it. max_distance=8 allows the player to see it from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at it. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks because it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining polished andesite with a pickaxe drops polished_andesite as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_andesite, so having at least 1 confirms they mined a block. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a golden helmet places it in the player's inventory. The player starts with no golden_helmet, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory.
